controls_execution_scope: Only exact original check_archive_hashes and archive_hash_controls FunctionDefs, extracted by AST from the complete verified afterimage and executed with assertions enabled under isolated Python3.12.10.
mandatory_boundaries_reviewed: verify_native checks original pure-wheel preservation, target/platform metadata, binary identity, embedded runtime manifest, source identity, and original wheel members before yielding native_proof.
wheel_requirement_bytes requires exact configured source SHA/tree and uv0.9.26; an absolute wheel under the owned native-wheel directory; positive bounded size; and a lowercase SHA-256 digest.

native_package exclusively creates the exact retained requirement bytes, verifies the owned wheel before installation, retains a failed binding first, then uses the original bounded command helper with --require-hashes --only-binary :all: --no-deps.
Successful binding requires unchanged requirement bytes/record and wheel record after the actual installer command. The binding retains the original command object.

Inventory admission regenerates exact requirement bytes and requires source identity, same wheel before/after/current record, exact pinned-uv argv, one matching original command, successful return, no timeout, and successful owned-group cleanup.

Inventory still validates installed RECORD hashes and sizes, original wheel-member hashes and sizes, executable mode, frozen versions, non-editable direct URL and its exact wheel URI. Only uv archive hash metadata may be empty; present metadata must match exactly.
The complete inventory marks mandatory installation/member binding only after those checks; the recovered predicate-only execution does not run those checks.
next_prerequisite: A separate exact4d107 source-metadata rebind and review must precede any source-bound installed successor; these controls alone do not authorize or prove that execution.
